conventions.floor: r <= n, the same as n >= 1/alpha - 1
conventions.position_base: 0-based indexes; the required index is r - 1; the linear helper lands at (n - 1) * q
conventions.reading_of_18_05: 18.05 is the linear 0-based position at q = 0.95 for n = 20. Pairing it with the rank required at level 0.90 is this sketch's reading of the abstract (the upper end of a two-sided interval is handed q = 0.95). UNVERIFIED: only the abstract was read.

measured.fixture: fixtures/main.json (8 cases on synthetic integer scores)
measured.grid: n = 1..300 and alpha = 0.01..0.20 in steps of 0.01 (6000 cases)
measured.note: counts come from hand-written helpers on an invented fixture and are not comparable with anything in the paper

on_unmeasured.why: Stated in the paper's abstract; not reproduced and not comparable with this sketch's fixture counts.

claims.what: a conformal interval at 0.90 carries its guarantee only at the right rank: a fresh score falls at or below the rth smallest of n with probability r/(n + 1)
at n = 20 the upper end of statsforecast's interval sits at position 18.05 where rank 19 is required
39 sites where a level becomes an index in 10 pinned packages, a named set rather than a systematic search; 12 classified by running them, 11 through their shared numpy method, the rest from source
all 7 tabular implementations reach the required rank
in darts, on one code path, coverage is unchanged (0.0000) where the ranks agree and 0.0280 to 0.0560 lower where they differ; a second archive repeats that split but not its range
below the feasibility floor n < 1/alpha - 1, of 14 public call paths 5 silently return a finite number; the rest raise or warn
statsforecast's default calibrates below its floor
6 of 19 upstream filings have merged, one fixing a coverage shortfall
a conformance suite classifies helpers by the rank they reach, and a checklist guides review
